run_distributed_training_torch: run a distributed training command on a single Gaudi node using torch.distributed with a specified world size
run_distributed_training_mpi: run a distributed training command on a single Gaudi node using OpenMPI with process mapping by socket
run_distributed_training_deepspeed: run a distributed training command on a single Gaudi node using DeepSpeed with a specified number of GPUs
run_multi_node_deepspeed: run a multi-node distributed training command using DeepSpeed with a hostfile specifying node addresses and slots
run_single_card_inference: run a single-card training or inference command optionally using DeepSpeed with one GPU
